description:
No.1 free driver updater. Automatically scan and update 9,500,000+ device drivers for a smoother PC.

Driver Booster is a free Windows software that scans your computer and updates over 9.5 million device drivers to improve performance. This software detects and installs newer versions of outdated, missing, or faulty drivers, and can also uninstall and reinstall problematic display drivers. The software includes a Game Boost feature to optimize your computer for better gaming and creates a restore point before making major updates.
v14.0 (2026-09-15)
- Database Expansion: Now covers 23,000,000+ drivers to support a wider range of devices
- Multi-Version Flexibility: Added multi-version scanning and updating, allowing users to choose their preferred driver version
- Reengineered Scanning Engine: Seamlessly detects both "latest" and "most stable" driver versions
- Revamped Installation Engine: Supports smooth, error-free multi-version driver installations
- New Fix Missing Game DLLs: Scans && repairs 60+ game components and 680+ DLLs, with real‑time missing‑DLL detection
- SOCKS5 Support: Added SOCKS5 proxy support to expand network configuration options
- Redesigned UI: Introduced a brand-new, modern-styled user interface
- Localization: Supports for 38 localized languages
